column1: # Review of the oracle-candidate sets (results/oracle_sets_for_review.txt), written by READING the sets only - no model output was consulted. Columns (TAB): id, kind, candidate description (or *), reason.

# DROP     the candidate is not a fair alternative: it is rendered as code (the describe() fallback printed the IR) or it is a description-level near-synonym of the gold ("energy used" vs "energy consumption"), so the descriptions alone cannot separate them. Removed from the corrected scoring.
# AMBIG    the QUESTION genuinely permits more than one of the offered readings (or the gold itself is questionable). Reported separately, excluded from the corrected denominator.
# UNDERSPEC the gold description omits something the question states (the diagnostic then under-tests that distinction). Kept, listed.
